title: Cauthon Silk Hives
description: a plugin for silk touch picking up hives with their bees included in them!!!
body:
## Features
Harvesting Beehives: Players can harvest beehives and bee nests using a Silk Touch tool.

Custom Item Metadata: The harvested item stores information about the number of bees contained in the original beehive.

Bee Spawning on Placement: When the custom beehive item is placed, the bees contained in it are spawned around the new block.

We have a discord now!!! [https://discord.gg/62493Tu5AD](https://discord.gg/62493Tu5AD)
